scenes.setting: Flat against the wall, Klein hears the bargain: Lady Despair will 'burn the house' and the Aurora Order may use the fire for their Lord's descent — then a courier's face resolves into Baelen, and the vanished slaves, Capim's girls and the missing textile women all point at one enormous hidden ritual underground
scenes.text_anchor: “Burn that house and bury all the clues there.”

scenes.setting: Set down in an East Borough alley, she walks the streets veiled and the fog thickens iron-black behind her — tramps coughing and dropping, workers clutching their throats across the docks and factory district. 'The Great Haze of Backlund.'

0-08 keeps writing over the black flooded valley: the Imperative Mage strips Azik of his two greatest powers, the stirred doors of spirit world and Underworld draw an unknown existence — and two bloody arms close on Zangwill's shoulders and pull him out of the world
